blocks.x: And he has a album of pictures that -- boy, that's the best album I've ever seen. And I was a very good friend of his. HI's wife promised to give me that album. You know, I wanted it.
There's pictures of all the guys you know -- way back -- the Midwest bands and things in it. I've just got to get that you know.
Anyhow, I'm going off and on and it seems like I'm wavering --
I don't mean to waver like that but these little things hit me at certain times and I -- I must express them while I've got them there you know that.
Right. Don't worry about that at all. That's quite all right.
Because if I don't get them then, I'll skip them and miss them -- you understand. So I was just saying is -- so, that's why I got this -- got him to get the band and you know he's running to type.
And we played different places around -- Indianapolis and all around -- you know.
